Body.Content:
These two Azure PowerShell releases include support and updates for:
  • Managed Cache - manage your cache and regenerate access keys
  • Azure Automation - manage your automation account, runbook, jobs, and schedule
  • Traffic Manager - manage your profile and endpoints
  • Anti-Malware Cloud Service extension - new management tools for the anti-malware extension
  • Virtual Machines and Networking - manage public IP, reserved IP, internal load balancer, VM image disks, and virtual network gateway keys
Body.Markdown:
These two Azure PowerShell releases include support and updates for:

Managed Cache - manage your cache and regenerate access keys

Azure Automation - manage your automation account, runbook, jobs, and schedule

Traffic Manager - manage your profile and endpoints

Anti-Malware Cloud Service extension - new management tools for the anti-malware extension

Virtual Machines and Networking - manage public IP, reserved IP, internal load balancer, VM image disks, and virtual network gateway keys
